data.raw_text:
We Almost Gave Up.

As a community founder, I’ve learned that building is easy during a bull market.
As someone who has worked closely with exchange leaders and Web3 founders, I’ve seen how quickly excitement fades when the market turns.
And as a believer in this space, I now understand that conviction is tested not when prices are high but when hope is low.

Building The Safehouse has not been easy.
There were months when engagement dropped.
Weeks when resources were stretched thin.
Moments when we questioned if continuing made sense.
We almost surrendered.
But Web3 was never meant to be built only in cycles of hype. It was meant to be built in seasons of resilience.

Here in the Philippines, access to proper Web3 education is still limited. Many enter the space through speculation — but very few are guided through fundamentals: blockchain basics, DeFi mechanics, responsible trading, risk management, and long-term thinking.
That is the gap we are trying to solve.

The Safehouse is not just a Discord server. It is a mission:
• To make Web3 education accessible in the PH
 • To create a safe environment for beginners and builders
 • To connect people who want to learn, teach, and grow together
 • To promote life, discipline, and opportunity with Web3 as a tool, not a shortcut

Today, I am making this public call.

We are looking for:
• Web3 professionals willing to share knowledge
 • Builders and founders who believe in grassroots education
 • Volunteers who want to help moderate, teach, organize, and grow a community
 • Partners who see long-term value in developing informed participants — not just users
If you are someone who believes education is the foundation of adoption, we want to work with you.

I also want to sincerely thank @cryptitaplays for the guidance, encouragement, and for helping us keep the fire alive during the hardest phases. Sometimes what keeps a community going isn’t funding — it’s mentorship and belief.

We are still here.
Still building.
Still committed.

If you want to help shape the future of Web3 education in the Philippines — my inbox is open.
Let’s build properly this time.

DSWD, Nakaagapay sa Agarang Aksyon sa Sunog Sa Maynila

Nagsagawa ng field monitoring ang Disaster Response Management Division kasama ang DSWD Field Office (FO) National Capital Region (NCR) at Manila City Social Welfare and Development Office kasunod ng naganap na sunog sa Intramuros, Maynila nitong Huwebes (Pebrero 25).

Umabot sa mahigit 500 pamilya ang pansamantalang nananatili sa nasabing evacuation center. Patuloy ang pakikipag-ugnayan ng DSWD FO-NCR sa City Government of Manila para matiyak ang agarang pamamahagi ng tulong at iba pang kinakailangang suporta sa mga apektadong pamilya.

#BawatBuhayMahalagaSaDSWD ❤️
